commands.note: the other half of the collision above: registers the binary-only signed update that `update` performs today, so the pair matches upstream

commands.note: registered; phase 4 makes it refuse user-modified files, announced for one release

commands.name: update
commands.note: SECOND NAME COLLISION, found during the phase 1 capture. ariadnev's `update` is a binary-only signed self-update, which is upstream's `self-update`. Upstream's `update` is the wider refresh that runs the binary step and then kit content. Phase 4 widens this one and phase 13 announces it; the binary-only path keeps working through the window

commands.name: run
commands.note: NAME COLLISION. `run` was the workflow harness; the harness moved to `av workflow` and the name is now reserved for skill dispatch, which phase 10 builds. A no-slash positional falls through to the harness with a deprecation warning until 1.4.0; a `<kit>/<skill>` positional refuses rather than being misrouted
